spans.notes: OLD_DESIGN: both penguins have bright yellow beaks and feet (~RGB 240,208,48) throughout, drawn flat (judged on the characters, as in Bromance). Content: the rose penguin washes and pats her face at a sink with a soap pump and tap (to ~f97), then the blue penguin at the same sink splashes his face (~f97-188), a gradual change ~f184-192 to the blue penguin standing alone with a sparkle (to f235), and a cut at f235/236 to both standing side by side while a used sheet mask lies at the rose one's feet. One reason for the whole run, so one span
